newsitem.title: FRANCE: Newspaper worker shot dead in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Newspaper worker shot dead in Algeria.

text.p: Suspected Moslem guerrillas in Algeria shot and killed a driver working for the government-controlled newspaper El Moudjahid, the newspaper said on Saturday.
Bellache Messaoud was shot dead on Friday night outside his home in Bajarah district south of Algiers, El Moudjahid said.
The newspaper blamed the killing on Moslem guerrillas.
More than 60 journalists and media workers have been killed in the past three years in attacks blamed on Moslem rebels who accuse journalists of backing the government.

About 60,000 people have been killed in Algeria's violence pitting Moslem guerrillas against government forces since 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
